sentences.text: Lola tenía un acuerdo verbal con el organizador, pero ninguno por escrito.
sentences.en: Lola had a verbal agreement with the organizer, but nothing in writing.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 주최 측과 구두 약속만 했지 서면 계약은 없었어요.

sentences.text: Sergio le contó al neurólogo que antes de la migraña veía un aura de luces.
sentences.en: Sergio told the neurologist that before a migraine he saw an aura of lights.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 신경과 의사에게 편두통 전에 빛이 번쩍이는 전조가 보인다고 말했어요.

sentences.text: La cantante tenía un aura especial que dejó a Lola sin palabras.
sentences.en: The singer had a special aura that left Lola speechless.
sentences.ko: 그 가수는 특별한 분위기가 있어서 롤라는 할 말을 잃었어요.

sentences.text: Sergio pulsó el timbre para alertar a la enfermera.
sentences.en: Sergio pressed the call button to alert the nurse.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 간호사에게 알리려고 호출 버튼을 눌렀어요.

sentences.text: Lola usó el móvil para alertar a sus amigas de que el concierto empezaba antes.
sentences.en: Lola used her phone to alert her friends that the concert was starting earlier.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 휴대폰으로 친구들에게 공연이 더 일찍 시작한다고 알렸어요.

sentences.text: El compañero de habitación de Sergio era un poco presumido y se peinaba antes de cada visita.
sentences.en: Sergio's roommate was a bit vain and combed his hair before every visit.
sentences.ko: 세르히오의 병실 동료는 좀 멋을 부리는 사람이라 면회 때마다 머리를 빗었어요.

sentences.text: El cantante era tan presumido que se miraba en cada pantalla, y Lola se reía.
sentences.en: The singer was so vain that he looked at himself on every screen, and Lola laughed.
sentences.ko: 가수가 너무 잘난 척해서 화면마다 자기 모습을 쳐다보자 롤라는 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Sergio intentó silbar en la sala de espera, pero una señora lo miró mal.
sentences.en: Sergio tried to whistle in the waiting room, but a lady gave him a dirty look.
sentences.ko: 세르히오가 대기실에서 휘파람을 불려고 하자 한 아주머니가 못마땅하게 쳐다봤어요.

sentences.text: Lola aprendió a silbar con dos dedos para animar a la banda.
sentences.en: Lola learned to whistle with two fingers to cheer on the band.
sentences.ko: 롤라는 밴드를 응원하려고 손가락 두 개로 휘파람 부는 법을 배웠어요.

sentences.text: El aparcamiento del hospital le costó a Sergio casi trescientos euros en un mes.
sentences.en: The hospital car park cost Sergio almost three hundred euros in one month.
sentences.ko: 세르히오는 병원 주차비로 한 달에 거의 삼백 유로를 냈어요.

sentences.text: Solo había trescientas personas en la sala, pero Lola sintió que eran miles.
sentences.en: There were only three hundred people in the hall, but Lola felt like there were thousands.
sentences.ko: 공연장에 삼백 명밖에 없었지만 롤라는 수천 명이 있는 것 같았어요.
